E100_min.note: Axial Young's modulus at least 38.6 GPa along x, y and z; equivalent by cubic symmetry.

args.note: For the tool's 316L material, E_s=193 GPa. The rigorous uniform-strain (Voigt) tensor bound for any single-solid/void periodic microstructure is C_eff <= phi C_s. Compliance ordering then gives E_axis <= phi E_s in each direction. With phi <= 0.16, E_axis <= 30.88 GPa, below the requested 38.6 GPa (=0.20 E_s). Thus no geometry in any allowed family can satisfy both constraints. A necessary, not sufficient, solid fraction for 38.6 GPa is at least 20%.
